$Comment: Hytale's Anniversary, one day a year for the day Hytale came out. The file name is the event id.
Start and End are the same day, so the event runs from the first moment of January 13th to the
last, counted in UTC because no Clock is written, every year from FirstYear on. FirstYear is the
Being on the server that day earns that year's copy of the Hytale_Anniversary achievement, which
pays the title Hytale_Anniversary_Ever_Present, and the Almanac marks the player as having taken
part. Nothing else hangs on it: no currency, keepsake or quest, and no file names it in a Season
leaf. Content of your own meant for the day alone can write Season: Hytale_Anniversary; a roll or
a lock reads ziggfreedcommon:calendar_live with Param Hytale_Anniversary.
Presentation names the day wherever events are listed, with the game's Old Map as its picture.
Herald.Start is the banner: it shows once to each player, the first time they are on the server
that day. There is no End banner, so the day closes quietly at midnight.
A server owner switches the day off, moves it, or gives it a Clock so it starts at their own
midnight, in mods/ziggfreedcommon/calendar.json without touching this file. Switched off, the day
earns no copy, and every copy a player already earned stays theirs.
/zigcalendar status Hytale_Anniversary shows what the server reads.
